description: This file defines a route component for creating a new note in a Remix application. It includes metadata, form handling logic, and a React component for rendering the note creation form.

methods.name: meta
methods.description: Returns metadata for the page, including the page title and description.

methods.name: action

methods.name: NewNoteRoute
